title: CPN (Maoist Centre) public demonstration and mass meeting on government performance
location: Ratnapark through Bagbazar, around Tundikhel, concluding at Exhibition Road, Kathmandu
threshold_50_evidence: Kathmandu Post calls it a mass gathering/mass meeting; Nepal Views confirms a demonstration and route, but no numerical count. Threshold needs independent assessment.

start_date.summary: Oct 26 actual event date; Kathmandu Post says Saturday Oct 26.

location.summary: Ratnapark/Bagbazar route; march around Tundikhel, meeting at Exhibition Road.

demands.summary: Government corruption, governance, selective investigations and disaster-management/relief response.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Qualitative “mass gathering/mass meeting” but no numeric estimate; pending reviewer.

state_response.summary: No response coding; reports do not establish absence.

notes: Actual date, route and government-accountability/corruption/disaster-response demands are reported. The two reports concern the same event; do not count twice.
open_questions: Can a contemporaneous independent report establish at least 50 simultaneous attendees?
Are Nepal Views and Kathmandu Post independent reporting for this event, and what is the episode end date?

title: RSP supporters’ demonstration after Rabi Lamichhane’s arrest
location: Maitighar Mandala toward New Baneshwor; stopped at Babarmahal, Kathmandu
threshold_50_evidence: Occurrence and state-directed demand are clear; no count or clear qualitative threshold.

start_date.summary: Article states event took place Oct 19, 2024.

location.summary: Maitighar toward New Baneshwor; police stopped march at Babarmahal.

demands.summary: Release of party chair Rabi Lamichhane after arrest.

state_target.summary: Demand addressed to arrest/detention process of domestic authorities.

state_response.summary: Police stopped march; whether this meets crowd-dispersal code needs review.

open_questions: Was the gathering at least 50 people simultaneously?
Does the police stop at Babarmahal meet the state-response crowd-dispersal definition?

title: Cooperative victims’ demonstration in Pokhara
threshold_50_evidence: No participant number or clear qualitative threshold; venue-size restriction is not attendance evidence.

location.summary: Mustang Chowk, Pokhara; venue changed after administrative order.

organizer.summary: Cooperative victims; named organizing body not specified.

demands.summary: Investigation of cooperative fraud and embezzled savings, including alleged investment in Gorkha Media.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: None; restriction on gatherings over 500 does not establish actual turnout.

state_target.summary: Administrative action/prohibition and demand for investigation; reviewer should assess target directness.

state_response.summary: An administrative order changed venue, but response relation to this gathering needs review.

open_questions: Was the demand directly directed to state authorities or primarily to private cooperative actors?

title: RSP cadres’ demonstration in Pokhara against chair’s arrest
threshold_50_evidence: The report confirms a separate gathering but gives no attendance.

start_date.summary: Article identifies the separate demonstration in the Oct 20 report.

demands.summary: Opposition to arrest of party chair; exact form of demanded state action not elaborated.

state_target.summary: Arrest by domestic authorities is the stated context.

open_questions: Did the reported protest explicitly demand state action beyond opposition to the arrest?
